board: Adafruit LC709203F LiPoly / LiIon Fuel Gauge and Battery Monitor (product 4712)
reason: Check passed on ESP32 and Pico: SMBus words low byte first with CRC-8-ATM PEC (verified against both datasheet examples), cell voltage 0x09 in mV, RSOC 0x0D in %, ITE 0x0F in 0.1 %, and the datasheet start-up flow in the driver. The real chip runs from the battery on the JST connector; the sim powers it from VIN.
